tasks.gr10-poetry-seen-unseen-t3: Topic: Reading poetry (seen and unseen) for Grade 10 English HL. Cover literal and figurative meaning, the speaker, imagery, simile, metaphor, personification, alliteration, assonance, onomatopoeia, rhyme scheme, rhythm, enjambment, repetition and refrain, tone, mood and theme, a routine for an unseen poem, answering 'why has the poet used...' questions, and the Paper 2 poetry section (30 marks: seen 20 from two of four poems, unseen 10; poetry essay 150 to 200 words). Use short original or public-domain extracts and ask about the effect of devices.
tasks.gr10-oral-communication-t3: Topic: Oral communication for Grade 10 English HL. Cover informative, evaluative, appreciative and interactive listening, the listening comprehension task (about 200 words, read at least twice, 15 marks), projection, intonation, stress, gesture and pause, debates, panel and forum discussions and turn-taking conventions, meeting procedure (chairperson, apologies, minutes, proposer and seconder, resolution), storytelling, and introducing a speaker. Ask about conventions and features, not delivery.
tasks.gr10-imaginative-transactional-t3: Topic: Imaginative and transactional writing for Grade 10 English HL. Cover choosing the right text from purpose and reader, register, person and tense for letters, reports, minutes and articles, a model formal letter of complaint (content, format, language), the 180 to 200 word limit for transactional texts, imaginative writing that shows rather than tells, the fifty-word story, and planning, counting and editing. Ask about format, register and content choices, never whether a whole text is good.
